title: AC1018 TABLE plot-style admission follow-up
question: Does the bounded AC1018 TABLE direct encoder reject a non-default plot-style reference when the route does not close its target graph?

finding.before: DRW_Entity::encodeDwgCommon emits a hard-pointer handle for a positive plotStyle value. The bounded TABLE route had no TABLE-specific check for the target's identity, role, or graph closure.
finding.change: Follow-up commit 3a1b249d's direct-codec-only restriction was removed. The direct TABLE codec serializes a positive plot-style handle; compound graph admission now requires exact identity with the staged default plot-style placeholder and requires that graph/frame to have been emitted. The generated TABLE vector refuses a dangling handle.
finding.scope: The prior direct-codec refusal is superseded by the compound graph-closure gate. This does not qualify a physical source profile or native plot-style semantics.
finding.fixtures: No DWG/DXF fixture was added; the control uses a generated in-memory TABLE object.

validation.result: PASS: AC1018 TABLE encoder allocation failures injected=19 rollback=PASS retry=PASS; AC1018/AC1021 TABLE cell override vectors: PASS

limitations: The graph gate covers only the existing default plot-style placeholder graph, not arbitrary plot-style records.
The generated test exercises dangling-target refusal; native plot-style meaning remains unqualified.
